ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近，我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关的新计时方法，而这些状况可能因全球变暖而改变。我们现在正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座时钟，它反映阿拉斯加几条主要河流的总流量，这些河流对地方和全球的环境变化十分敏感。我们已对它编程：如果水道继续以目前速率流动，它就与原子钟同步；如果未来河流平均流速加快，时钟就会跑在标准时间前面；如果变慢，则会出现相反效果。

ex.s: When I was 17， I read a magazine article about a museum called the McNay， once the home of a watercolorist named Marian McNay． She had requested the community to turn it into a museum upon her death． On a sunny Saturday， Sally and I drove over to the museum． She asked， "Do you have the address？ ""No， but I'll recognize it， there was a picture in the magazine．
ex.t: 我17岁时，读到一篇杂志文章，介绍一家叫麦克奈的博物馆，它曾是水彩画家玛丽安·麦克奈的故居。她曾要求社区在她去世后将其改为博物馆。一个阳光明媚的周六，萨莉和我开车去了博物馆。她问："你有地址吗？""没有，但我会认出来的，杂志上有照片。"

ex.s: The museum was free． We entered， excited． A group of people sitting in the hall stopped talking and stared at us．
ex.t: 博物馆免费。我们兴奋地走进去。大厅里坐着的一群人停下交谈，盯着我们看。

ex.s: Thirty years later， a woman approached me in a public place． "Excuse me， did you ever enter a residence， long ago， thinking it was the McNay Museum？"
ex.t: 三十年后，一位女士在公共场所走近我。“打扰一下，你很久以前是否曾进过一户住宅，以为那是麦克奈博物馆？”

ex.s: "That was my home． I was a teenager sitting in the hall． Before you came over， I never realized what a beautiful place I lived in． I never felt lucky before． You thought it was a museum． My feelings about my home changed after that． I've always wanted to thank you．"
ex.t: “那是我家。我当时是个坐在厅里的少年。你来之前，我从没意识到自己住的地方多美。我以前从没觉得自己幸运。你以为那是博物馆。从那以后我对家的感觉变了。我一直想谢谢你。”

ex.s: She was a museum director．
ex.t: C．她是一位博物馆馆长。
